## Capability outcome

## Capability type

Parser / protocol adapter / ML model / topology inference / import-export

## Source and licensing

Library/model URL, version, license, attribution and transitive dependency review. Reference the authoritative inventory and unresolved licensing questions in `compliance/third_party_inventory.json` and `docs/testing/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE-INVENTORY.md`:

## Input and output contract

Describe accepted evidence, normalized observations, confidence, provenance and failure behavior.

## Permissions and safety profile

Passive/active classification, required permissions, resource limits and prohibited behavior:

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] Signed manifest/package
- [ ] Deterministic fixture corpus
- [ ] Malformed-input or adversarial tests
- [ ] Evidence references retained
- [ ] No silent inventory mutation
- [ ] Documentation and attribution updated
- [ ] Human validation completed where required

## Non-goals
